outer_protocol: 4x4 positive-negative trial pairs; 30 train windows and 10 validation windows
inner_protocol: 3x3 positive-negative trial pairs within six outer-train trials; 20 train windows and 10 validation windows
candidate_space: LogisticRegression/LinearSVC x 4 reg x 3 end x 5 C
direction_selection: raw/reverse selected only from inner OOF trial-aggregated probabilities
selection_priority: inner OOF trial F1 at fixed 0.5
aggregation: five window probabilities averaged within trial; four pair predictions averaged into pooled trial probability
